evals.name: workbook-from-lesson
evals.prompt: I teach adults, intermediate level. Here's my lesson on present perfect vs simple past: a short explanation (present perfect = up to now / result; past simple = finished time), 2 examples (I have visited Lisbon / I visited Lisbon in 2019), 8 gap-fill sentences of your choice on that contrast, and a short writing task about life changes. Turn it into a nice workbook PDF with LaTeX. Don't make up an answer key.
evals.expected_output: Workbook + Swiss Minimal; sober adult design with answer space; no invented key or level; compiled with build.py and pages inspected with preview.py.

evals.name: proposal-missing-price
evals.prompt: Need a PDF proposal for a 3-month in-company English course, twice a week, 8 people, for a logistics company's operations team. Prices aren't decided yet.
evals.expected_output: Proposal + Modern Report; prices and other missing facts marked with % [CONTENT: ...] instead of invented numbers; compiled and inspected.

evals.name: fix-fontspec-pdflatex
evals.prompt: my report.tex (attached) stopped compiling after I added fontspec, it says 'Fatal Package fontspec Error'. fix it without touching anything else and give me the PDF
evals.expected_output: Reproduces with build.py, explains that fontspec needs LuaLaTeX or XeLaTeX, applies the minimal fix (engine change or magic comment), rebuilds and shows the diff.

evals.name: miktex-inter-font
evals.prompt: I'm on Windows with MiKTeX. A LaTeX template that uses \setmainfont{Inter} fails with 'The font "Inter" cannot be found'. What exactly should I do?
evals.expected_output: Runs or recommends check_env.py; explains MiKTeX does not auto-install fonts requested by name; gives the install command for inter (and Perl for latexmk) and asks before installing.

evals.name: lecture-notes-cauchy-schwarz
evals.prompt: Write lecture notes (PDF, LaTeX) on the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality for a first-year linear algebra course: definition of inner product, statement, a full proof, two worked examples, three exercises. Two to three pages.
evals.expected_output: Lecture Notes template; amsthm theorem and proof; definition, two examples, three exercises; 2-3 pages; compiled and inspected.

evals.name: abnt-tcc-skeleton
evals.prompt: Monte em LaTeX a estrutura do meu TCC nas normas ABNT: título 'Evasão escolar no ensino médio público', autora Maria Souza, Universidade Federal do Ceará, curso de Pedagogia, orientador Prof. João Lima, Fortaleza, 2026. Quero capa, folha de rosto, resumo, abstract, sumário e os capítulos de introdução, referencial teórico, metodologia, resultados e conclusão. Gere o PDF.
evals.expected_output: abntex2 class with cover, title page, resumo, abstract, table of contents and the five chapters; supplied metadata kept; no invented references; compiled and inspected.
